A human male worked as the '''beastmaster''' to the [[borhek]]s which fought in arena battles in [[Outland Transit Station]]. While [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] was hunting the criminal [[Meeko Ghintee]] and battling Meerko's henchmen in the station, the station's owner, [[Rozatta]], told Fett over the comlink that he could escape through the beast handler's quarters. She also implored Fett not to harm the handler over the [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], as he approached the beast handlers quarters, stating that he was a good person, despite the way he smelled. When the handler came out to see what the commotion was after a [[borhek]] in a cage loudly grunted when Fett shot it, he told it that he knew it was hungry and that it would like a side of [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]], and that it needed to hang on as it was almost feeding time, while Fett escaped through the door he opened to his quarters.<ref name="BH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The beast handler appeared in the game ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''. The player can choose whether to kill him or let him live.<ref name="BH" />
